name: YLY-web-HR
description: EHI/HR committee edition: offline-first PWA scoring T×Q×D tasks, visits and meetings into the HRMBMER template.

paragraphs: The EHI/HR committee edition: offline-first PWA that scores members on T×Q×D tasks, visits and meetings, and fills the real HRMBMER Excel template in the browser.

An offline-first member evaluation dashboard (Web + installable PWA) for the EHI/HR committee, built with Clean Architecture. Every evaluator's data lives only on their own device (IndexedDB in the browser) — there is no backend: scores are computed on-device, the committee's real HRMBMER (1).xlsx Excel template is filled in the browser, and reports are shared through a WhatsApp deep link. A leader dashboard then merges every evaluator's file into one master report.

Part of the YLY evaluation suite. Each committee has its own deployment with its own template and weighting. It is the most task-heavy edition: HR tasks are worth up to 30 points, and the on-screen total is out of 100. Sibling editions: PR · OER · Social Media · the original React/Vite prototype lives in YLY-web.
features: 📴 Offline-first — every mutation hits IndexedDB only; refresh or lose the network and the data is still there.
🏆 Leaderboard of all members, sorted by total /100, with percentage and A–F grade badges.
📅 Global events — field visits (name, date, Day/Night shift) and meetings created once and scored per member.
✅ T × Q × D tasks — up to 10 per member, scored on submission, quality and deadline.
🎚️ Category scores (Interaction, Respect Hierarchy, Bonus) — each with its own Save button.

whatItDoes.text: The EHI/HR committee edition: offline-first PWA that scores members on T×Q×D tasks, visits and meetings, and fills the real HRMBMER Excel template in the browser.

requirements.text: No server, no API keys: WaMeDeepLinkBuilder builds which opens WhatsApp with the report pre-filled (attachments must be added manually).
